top_signals.title: Copper Market Squeeze Intensifies as More Metal Is Shipped to US
top_signals.summary: A surge in copper shipments to the US in anticipation of a potential decision to impose import tariffs is creating a severe market squeeze, pushing global prices close to a record high as buyers scramble to secure supplies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
